builds.title: Base Game Seraphine
builds.author: Ornilia
builds.style: Queen Anne brick farmhouse: a cascade of front gables over a dark shingle roof with twin chimneys and dormers, white-columned front porch, book-lined open ground floor, lakeside pool garden

builds.title: Base Game Lake Cabin
builds.author: MadamRedo
builds.style: Stepped lake house standing in the water: a greige gable block with a glazed prow, a long catslide over a set-back upper floor with a stone chimney, a single-storey flat-roofed kitchen wing with a clerestory and a glass corner, a planted bank and a dark deck with a telescope over the pond

builds.title: Villa Mesa Mariposa
builds.author: Schnucko
builds.style: Mid-century desert villa: split dark shed roofs with rust fascias over caramel stucco, a glass-roofed conservatory dining room on the street corner, a glazed tower, a recessed entry with a slab canopy, one-bay garage; a walled resort garden round a turtle-mosaic pool

builds.title: Valley-View Villa
builds.author: Axiisims
builds.style: Powder-blue riverside villa: a set-back upper storey behind a full-width glass balcony, thin cream cantilevered slabs, a honey-timber pier portal, a curtained cabana on the water, an L-shaped glass-edged pool and a walled five-a-side pitch on a paved plaza

builds.title: Base Game Family Home
builds.author: TheClumsySimmer
builds.style: Two-storey sage-yellow lap-siding family home: hipped roof with two overlapping street gables, one-storey gabled west wing, gabled entry portico and picket-railed wrap veranda, warm cream living room with a garden bay, and a backyard homestead (lily pond gazebo, greenhouse, raised beds, monkey bars)

builds.title: BG Modern Asymmetry House
builds.author: SimsWithNora
builds.style: Four stepped tiers on a lake lot: a garage podium, a raised main floor reached up an exterior stair between stepped planters, a plunge-pool terrace on the podium roof, dark timber bays, corner balconies and two offset penthouse boxes, all under thin dark flat roofs

builds.title: Base Game Aurora
builds.author: Ornilia
builds.style: Layered white modern villa: picture-frame boxes with charcoal and taupe infill, a floating roof slab over two dark pavilions, a carport terrace, a front balcony and a pool forecourt on a canal

builds.title: Base Game House BG Family
builds.author: Turbogoku
builds.style: Stepped white-render cottage: a tall narrow porch gable, a low 1.5-storey centre gable and a smaller stone-bay gable under a full-width dark side-gabled roof, a glazed side lounge under a glass gable, picket-fenced hydrangea front, lap pool behind a white privacy fence

builds.title: Base Game House
builds.author: olciaxxx_05
builds.style: Raised periwinkle lap-siding house over a garage storey: a projecting front-gabled garage wing with a pent roof, the front door recessed beside it up a long white-railed exterior stair, stepped cross gables and a big dormer, brick chimney, Italian cypress, arborvitae and birch

builds.title: Cocoon Base Game
builds.author: Schnuck01
builds.style: Two-storey teal-siding colonial, hipped roof with a big front cross gable and a nested bay gable, forward garage and inset-porch entry gables, low hipped east wing; warm taupe fireside interior; enclosed stone pool terrace

builds.title: Cute Basegame Starter
builds.author: TheClumsySimmer
builds.style: Slate-blue clapboard Cape Cod: steep brown side gable with two dormers and an end chimney, a gabled entry bay, white-railed porches either side, a lower bath wing

builds.title: Epiphany
builds.author: Schnuck01
builds.style: 1.5-storey oxblood-brick house under one steep bronze roof that steps down west to a lower wing and the garage; a two-storey black-framed glazed slot, a black glazed entry pair in the east bay, a gravel forecourt with a rock-edged sweep bed

builds.title: Base Game Family House
builds.author: SimsWithNora
builds.style: Mid-century raised ranch: tuck-under garage between fieldstone piers under a balcony room, the main floor a storey up behind a long loggia, pale ashlar under a tall west shed and a low east gable with brown fascias, a switchback stoop through terraced planters, stepping stones across a cottage garden

builds.title: Base Game Flowery Cottage
builds.author: MadamRedo
builds.style: Single-storey lakeside cottage: a cluster of blue-green board-and-batten cross-gables under olive shingle, a flat meadow-roofed glass sunroom, a creek and jetty in a dense cottage garden

builds.title: Garden Nook (Base Game)
builds.author: HoldenRoark
builds.style: Single-storey powder-blue painted-brick cottage: a clay swoop skillion rising west to a white outrigger post meets a front-facing clay gable in a V; white-columned porch, recessed kitchen loggia, glass garden nook; gravel S-curve between flower-packed beds, rear deck and round plunge tub

builds.title: Base Game Mediterranean
builds.author: TheClumsySimmer
builds.style: Symmetrical warm-white stucco villa: a two-storey centre with pavilion hips over box bays and a recessed arched entry under an iron balcony, single-storey hipped wings, dark timber posts and geranium window boxes, a walled cypress forecourt with a tiered fountain, three rear arches onto a mosaic pool terrace with a pergola

builds.title: The Mirage
builds.author: Schnuck01
builds.style: Terraced hillside modern: a fieldstone plinth lifts the main floor, loggia and pool terrace a storey above a jungle bank and lily pond; a glass stair tower, a cantilevered bedroom floor on walnut floor bands and a setback clerestory crown it

builds.title: Base Game Modern Home
builds.author: SimsWithNora
builds.style: Layered blue-and-white modern: a white-framed upper box with a recessed glass-railed loggia, a charcoal portal round the glazed stair, blue-grey concrete below, and a rear roof terrace with a plunge pool over the bedroom; walnut-and-leather living room behind west glass onto a slatted pergola patio

builds.title: Base Game Modern House
builds.author: SimsWithNora
builds.style: Two near-equal modern volumes under opposed dark sheds: a one-storey west wing falling west over a fin-framed recessed porch, and a two-storey east block falling east with its upper storey set back behind a planted white band; blue-grey siding, walnut pilasters, a charcoal forecourt and a reflecting basin in front, a timber pool deck wrapping the back

builds.title: Base Game Modern House 1
builds.author: SimsWithNora
builds.style: Two-storey modern: a dark-timber flat-roofed box under a floating two-band lid, carried on white and striped piers, stands forward of a white, steep street gable with a projecting open rake; a stair slot window, a glazed entry pair, a two-pane bay; gravel forecourt, deck with a rill and ball shrubs, a basin by the drive

builds.title: Base Game Newcrest House
builds.author: xxSarina_27xx
builds.style: Tall narrow steep-gable lake house: white stucco and black trim, a street-level garden floor under a raised front terrace, main floor up an exterior stair, low west wing

builds.title: The New Eco Base Game
builds.author: plnch25
builds.style: Two-storey eco-modern: a sage tower pushing through the eave of a rust-shingle side gable, pale-blue boarded upper storey under a glass A-frame prism, a one-storey glass sunroom with banded window-walls, a deep gabled garage with a dormer, broad timber entry steps in tropical beds

builds.title: Base Game One-Story House
builds.author: SimsWithNora
builds.style: One-storey cornflower-blue cottage: steep terracotta side gable, wide front cross gable, gabled dormer, gabled entry vestibule, west brick chimney, cottage foundation beds, rear L with a railed dining deck over an oval pool

builds.title: The Palms Base Game Fix
builds.author: Schnuck01
builds.style: Desert-modern: blue-grey fieldstone base with a black-framed portal onto a planted atrium, a two-storey stone and glass block showing its floating stair, stepped brown standing-seam sheds, a resort back yard with terraces, pool, spa gazebo and palms

builds.title: Paln Knoll of Ermosa
builds.author: Schnuck01
builds.style: Split-level white modern on a knoll: a projecting glazed tower between a lower entry block and a shed-roofed garage wing, thin charcoal slab roofs, two flights of stone steps to a parapet-walled entry, a raised terrace and cascading pools in curved tropical beds

builds.title: Payorote (Base Game)
builds.author: plnch25
builds.style: Treehouse: dark-timber pods on a stilted deck wrapped round a giant lantern-hung host tree, a ladder up from a wildflower meadow, a crow's nest and a canopy pod above, a lake behind

builds.title: Riverbend Drive
builds.author: Schnuck01
builds.style: Two-storey two-tone brick family traditional on a riverside lot: one long side-gabled ridge with a single dormer, three wall gables across the front (brick over the garage, a tall brick centre gable, a whitewashed gable over a recessed glazed entry), a pent roof over the garage, a bay under its own hip, a lower hipped east wing with the hearth chimney; a rock-edged stream and topiary cones in front, a lily pond and willow on the west lawn, the river behind

builds.title: Base Game Starter 18k 2/1
builds.author: Ornilia
builds.style: Single-storey brick cottage: steep brown side gable with two dormers and a west-end chimney, twin front-gabled glass wings flanking a recessed glazed entry, open walnut living-dining-kitchen, one long family bedroom with a kids' corner, covered back porch and a privacy-fenced yard

builds.title: Base Game Sunny Home
builds.author: MadamRedo
builds.style: Modern barn cluster: a brick-and-glass lounge gable and a taller two-storey curtain-wall gable under black roofs, a set-back timber entry wing, cypresses, a round plunge pool below a dining deck

builds.title: Base Game Vanilla House
builds.author: MadamRedo
builds.style: Stepped five-part modern farmhouse in white brick: glass-box greenhouse, tall front gable, flat-roofed box, front-gabled living wing and a canopied east entry, behind a serpentine gravel path, deep planted beds and a lap pool
